PC and Mac specs

Dressmaker System Requirements

Dressmaker is a small game, and the official specs say so. Steam asks for Windows 10 or later, an Intel Core i5 or AMD Ryzen processor, 8 GB of RAM, Intel UHD 630 or better graphics and DirectX 11. On Mac it asks for an Apple M1 and 8 GB of RAM. Both platforms need 1 GB of free storage.

Reviewed September 21, 2026

  • Windows10 or later
  • ProcessorIntel Core i5 or AMD Ryzen
  • Memory8 GB RAM
  • GraphicsIntel UHD 630 or better
  • macOSApple M1 minimum
  • Storage1 GB available space

Dressmaker is undemanding. On Windows it needs Windows 10 or later, an Intel Core i5 or AMD Ryzen, 8 GB RAM, Intel UHD 630 graphics, DirectX 11 and 1 GB of storage; on Mac, an Apple M1 and 8 GB RAM. Steam publishes a minimum tier only, so there is no recommended spec.

Dressmaker is a hand-drawn 2D crafting sim, not a 3D world, so the dressmaker game asks for very little.

Will it run on my machine?

Verdicts for the machines readers ask about.

MachineVerdictNotes
Older laptop, Intel HD or UHD integrated graphics (roughly 2016-2019)Usually fineClears the graphics line only with 8 GB of RAM
Modern thin-and-light, Iris Xe or Ryzen integrated graphics (2021 or newer)Comfortably above the minimumNothing to tune
Gaming desktop or laptop with a dedicated GPUFar above the minimumNothing here to change
Apple Silicon Mac (M1, M2, M3 or M4)Meets the published minimum, or beats itThe base 8 GB configuration is enough
Intel Mac, any modelNot covered by the official specNothing published about Intel Macs, so we cannot say it runs

Windows, line by line

Two lines decide it; the rest is a formality.

  • 8 GB of RAM — the line that disqualifies old machines. 8 GB has been standard since around 2016; a 2015 laptop with 4 GB falls short.
  • Intel UHD 630 or better — the real graphics floor, and lower than it sounds.
  • The rest is free — Windows 10 or later, DirectX 11 and 1 GB of space are met by any Windows PC from the last decade, and Steam names no CPU generation, so any mainstream i5 or Ryzen qualifies.

What "Intel UHD 630 or better" actually means

Intel UHD 630 is integrated graphics: a GPU built into the processor, shipped in Intel's 8th-generation chips from around 2017.

So the floor is integrated graphics from about 2017 or newer. Intel's Iris Xe and Arc, AMD's Ryzen graphics and any dedicated card from the last decade all clear it.

Mac: Apple M1 and newer

The macOS minimum names Apple M1 and nothing else, so it means Apple Silicon: any M1, M2, M3 or M4 Mac meets it.

An Intel Mac is not covered by the published requirement, and we will not pretend otherwise: the developers have published nothing about Intel Macs. The Dressmaker demo page is the honest way to test the water first.

Disk space and download size

The 1 GB storage line is the round number the publisher typed into Steam's field. The real figures come from SteamDB, which tracks Steam's depots.

PlatformOn diskDownload size
Windows1.19 GiB installedroughly 296 MB
macOS1.22 GiB installedroughly 309 MB

Steam compresses what it sends, so the download is about a third of the installed size.

Note

the free prototype is a bigger download than the full game. The 0.5.5 zips on itch.io are 115 MB for Windows, 127 MB for Linux and 128 MB for macOS - a separate build with its own Linux version, so it says nothing about the released game.

If Dressmaker stutters or will not start

Work through these in order. The first two fix most problems.

  1. 1

    Close background apps

    browsers, Discord overlays and cloud-sync clients all take a slice of the same 8 GB.

  2. 2

    Update your graphics driver

    integrated Intel graphics improve with driver updates, and Windows Update often leaves you on an old one. Get the current driver from Intel, AMD or NVIDIA directly.

  3. 3

    Lower the resolution

    if the game offers a window size or quality setting, drop it a step.

  4. 4

    Verify the game files in Steam

    right-click Dressmaker, open Properties, then Installed Files, and run “Verify integrity of game files.”

  5. 5

    Check the game's own settings menu

    the developers have not published a graphics options list, so the menu is the authority.

Crashes, black screens and the macOS security prompt get a longer checklist on the Dressmaker troubleshooting page. Stuck on your first commission instead? The how to play Dressmaker walkthrough is the better place to be.

The fine print

Copied from the official Steam listing on September 21, 2026, launch day. Requirement fields are editable publisher text, so any line could move; the Dressmaker Steam release date page tracks the platform list.
